name: Rowbly Stats
description:
Add a stats page per board. This page should show the following:

- Cards created
- Cards moved to done
- PR's created
- Commits created.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: User metric definitions resolved explicitly: current records only, existing Stories and Stories currently in Stage Category done; all-time window; unique PRs currently linked to this Board Stories; unique commits in those linked PRs. Exclude deleted Story history, historical Done transitions, unlinked historical PRs and tracker/repository-wide commit counts. Unknown or unavailable sources must remain distinct from zero. Worker must refine the read-only Board Stats page/CLI and Plugin-owned contribution plan around these definitions, then await supervisor implementation acceptance. No implementation authorized by these metric answers alone.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Research and proposed plan awaiting supervisor acceptance. Isolated worktree /home/sgolovine/Projects/rowbly-worktrees/row-70-story on factory/row-70 from origin/main d44db09e72b243757264a6504c5e5360a97ad571. Story records contain creation timestamps and current Stage but no Done-transition history. GitHub Plugin stores one current PR URL per Story and its fixed live read has no creation date or commits. Git has no Board-to-code-commit association. Proposed scope is a shared read-only Board Stats page and CLI aggregation with Plugin-owned contributions, explicit unavailable sources, matching documentation, existing-test extensions, screenshots and all four checks. No product implementation until metric semantics and plan are explicitly accepted.
